event_chain.summary: Insider misuse of DAVID and Flock databases

summary: Sarasota (Florida) Police Department officer Cory Waiters was fired and arrested on August 19, 2026 for allegedly misusing law-enforcement-only search databases, including DAVID (Florida driver and vehicle records) and Flock camera records. The department learned of the misuse on August 6, placed him on leave, and ran an agency-wide database audit. He faces felony computer crime and official misconduct charges; the department did not say what was searched.
